punchline: It was called smokeless; its taste and smell lost the smokers.
thirty_sec: RJR's Premier cigarette went into US test markets in 1988 and heated tobacco instead of burning it. Ads said 'clean smoke', the press said 'smokeless'; it was hard to light and tasted bad, and Reynolds ended it on 28 February 1989.
question: Which thing you are about to roll out have you not yet tried with a first-time user?
key_contrast: The promise was big; the thing in the hand did not carry it.
